core_rule: Persist material workspace state as part of doing the work rather than waiting for an end-of-thread continuity audit.

capability_boundary.ordinary_chatgpt: Agentic persistence can occur while a persistence-capable assistant turn is active, but this environment does not expose a guaranteed universal event hook for every new thread, every turn, app close, deletion, or historical-chat export.
capability_boundary.true_zero_touch: Requires an external event producer or a purpose-built client/workbench that owns the request path and persists each visible event automatically.

modes.limitation: Cannot discover a separate ChatGPT thread if no persistence-capable action is invoked in that thread.

modes.rule: Raw transcripts and restricted/private material do not auto-flow to the public repository.

modes.guarantee: Every user-visible workspace event can be persisted because the capture layer sits in the request path.

fallback.purpose: Chronological checkpoint ledger when a dedicated event store is deferred

future_thread_default: When a substantive Por Derecho workspace is recognised and GitHub access is available, initialise/recover a PD-WS workspace and checkpoint material state without waiting for an explicit continuity-audit request.
